author: gsnnun
quote: I’m left wondering: "What if they hadn’t made a 1:1 remake?" But you know what? It doesn’t really matter. A masterpiece! Quite simply one of the greatest games of all time, and a delight for anyone who appreciates a simple, well-told, and timeless story.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: gsnnun
quote: For those new to this genre, the game’s difficulty might be intimidating at first. But honestly? The sense of progression is incredible, and the replay value has been crafted with great care. Am I hoping for an Elden Ring 2? I don’t just want a DLC.

author: gsnnun
quote: Simply one of the best games I have ever played in my life. Everything an RPG deserves to have can be found within this game. Just play it!

author: gsnnun
quote: A game with Souls-like elements, set in a world with a shinobi/ninja/samurai aesthetic; it features frenetic action, though it can be a bit nauseating. It’s definitely not a bad game.

author: gsnnun
quote: Freedom might be captivating at first, but that alone doesn’t make for a great video game. Perhaps it’s time for the industry to start focusing on telling good stories, rather than just banking on the hype surrounding expectations—expectations that can easily be **** if profit is prioritized over the care put into crafting a quality game. Could it be that, a few months or years down the line—once bugs are patched and, perhaps, some DLC is released—GTA VI might deserve a higher score?
